text: The authors summarise Lightman et al. as finding that process-supervised reward models significantly outperform outcome-supervised ones for reranking on MATH. They say such work studies PRMs only in an IID setting, whereas they train PRMs on easy problems and show these easy-to-hard evaluators can improve generation on hard problems.
title: Sun et al. move Lightman et al.'s process reward models from IID MATH to easy-to-hard generalization
